voice.name: Open Sector - Xenomorph Swarm
voice.note: Shares the Xenomorph Swarm voice designed for the Leech (voices/leech.json); cold and watchful for the hover craft.
voice.description: A fast, hissing swarm chorus of many small synthetic voices speaking the same words together, like a hive of insect-like machines piloting alien craft: thin and sharp, raspy and buzzing, with dry clicking and a faint wet chitter between words, emotionless and eager, quick clipped cadence, a slightly metallic hollow resonance under the voice.

fire.prompt: One short sci-fi laser pulse fired straight down from a hovering alien craft: a crisp bright electric zap with a quick searing sizzle, energy weapon, no gunpowder, no explosion, close, outdoors, no music, no voice

move.prompt: Alien hover craft gliding slowly overhead: a deep steady pulsing hum of anti-gravity vanes, a soft organic warble and faint electric crackle, no engine roar, no jet, outdoors, no music, no voice

die.prompt: Alien hover craft shot down: the steady hum breaks into a falling electric whine, crackling energy arcs and a wet organic shriek, then a heavy crash and green energy burst on the ground, medium distance outdoors, no music, no voice
